reason: Two fresh Java-valid held-outs fail the no-oracle comparison on the deployment backend. Both preserve the requested storage/artifact primitive and text stack but place the root cluster five pixels too far left and make the canvas five pixels too narrow. A valid counterexample rejects the cross-backend identity claim.

java_model_findings: DescriptionDiagramFactory registers one CommandPackageWithUSymbol command for the DESCRIPTION surface, and CommandPackageWithUSymbol passes USymbols.fromString(symbol, ...) directly to diagram.gotoGroup.
USymbolStorage.asBig draws a rounded URectangle, places stereotype at local y=5, and places title at local y=7 plus stereotype height.
USymbolArtifact.asBig draws the rounded body plus the folded-page polygon, and places both stereotype and title at local y=2 with the title following stereotype height.
ClusterHeader derives title dimensions from merged stereotype/title blocks and adds only the selected symbol's supplement; these two symbols do not add a shape supplement in the cited implementation.

LimitFinder expands URectangle extrema by one pixel and UPolygon X extrema by ten pixels; SvekResult then translates the painted minimum to six pixels and reports a fifteen-pixel dimension delta. These rules describe the painted envelope, not an unconditional cluster-frame origin.
rust_model_findings: The component parser now retains ComponentPackageKind::Storage and ::Artifact, and the component renderer dispatches both to the shared storage/artifact primitive helpers with the Java text offsets.
The deployment parser retains DeploymentNodeKind::Storage and ::Artifact, and the deployment renderer dispatches both to the corresponding cluster primitive helpers.

The four component-routed cases emitted Rust component inventories under DIFF_ONE_DEBUG and all passed. The four deployment-routed cases used deployment-exclusive storage/artifact container scoring; two passed and two failed.

The component frame code assigns Storage and Artifact the generic MARGIN origin (7), while component_cluster_painted_max special-cases Artifact's right extent but does not derive the frame origin from the complete painted envelope.
The deployment path has the analogous symbol-local painted bounds, but the failing root layouts show that the shared frame/canvas translation is not preserved when root topology changes.

fixture_keyed_logic_audit.result: No fresh perturbation labels, ids, or directory names were found in shipping Rust. The implementation constants inspected were generic symbol geometry and adjacent Java-model comments; the rejection is behavioral, not a fixture-keyed branch finding.

conclusion: REJECT. The corrected component-backend symbol variants survive four fresh component-routed cases, and the deployment backend passes four simpler/root-nested cases. The two fresh deployment counterexamples show that the claimed USymbol identity does not yet include the complete frame-origin and canvas-envelope behavior across root topology. The review record and all eight same-stem Java SVG pairs are preserved under test-diagrams/perturbations/description-container-usymbol-identity/followup2/; no shipping Rust was changed.
